params.1273: Craft an air rune at the Air Altar.
params.1274: You need some rune essence. The fastest way to get this is to click on your wicked hood and then select 'essence'.
params.1275: Click on the Air Altar with some rune essence and you'll bind the essence into air runes.
params.2225: If you need more rune essence than the hood can provide, you can get more by teleporting to the Essence Mine and mining it yourself. Carwen Essencebinder can teleport you.
